;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Operation Barkhane]]
**Two [[France|French]] soldiers are killed after their armoured vehicle hits a [[Improvised explosive device|roadside bomb]] in [[Mali]]. [http://www.france24.com/en/20180221-mali-french-soldiers-killed-explosive-device-sahel (France 24)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**The [[Nigerian Armed Forces|Nigerian military]] rescues 76 schoolgirls taken on Monday during a Boko Haram raid on the village of [[Dapchi]], [[Yobe State]]. The bodies of two girls were recovered, and at least thirteen other students remain missing. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security/nigeria-rescues-76-schoolgirls-after-boko-haram-attack-others-missing-idUSKCN1G51DU (Reuters)] [https://www.dailytrust.com.ng/army-rescued-missing-schoolgirls-from-terrorists-yobe-govt.html (''Daily Trust'')]
*[[2018 Lashio bombing]]
**A bomb explodes at a bank in [[Lashio]], [[Shan State]], in northern Myanmar, killing two employees and injuring 22 others. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/02/21/world/asia/-yoma-bank-bombing-in-lashio-myanmar-signals-strife-beyond-the-rohingya.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-blast/two-dead-22-hurt-from-bomb-blast-in-northeast-myanmar-city-lashio-idUSKCN1G51N9 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A coach transiting the [[Pan-American Highway]] plunges off the road in [[Arequipa Region|Arequipa]], [[Peru]], killing 44 people. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-43140484 (BBC)]
*A ferry [[explosion]] at the [[Playa del Carmen]]'s pier in [[Mexico]] injures 18 people. None of the injuries appear to be life-threatening. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/reports-of-injuries-in-ferry-explosion-in-mexico/ar-BBJqrGA?pfr=1 (CBS News via MSN)]

;International relations
*[[Foreign relations of South Korea]]
**[[South Korea]] signs free trade agreements with the [[Central America]]n countries of [[Costa Rica]], [[El Salvador]], [[Honduras]], [[Nicaragua]], and [[Panama]] to eliminate duties on about 95% of traded goods and services. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-trade-centralamerica/south-korea-signs-free-trade-deals-with-5-central-america-countries-idUSKCN1G502X (Reuters)]
;Politics and elections
*[[Stoneman Douglas High School shooting]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] meets in the [[White House]] [[State Dining Room of the White House|State Dining Room]] with parents and friends of young people killed in school shootings to discuss what needs to be done. Suggestions for the president included a number of items to make schools safer, and for Trump to "put politics aside" and back gun control measures. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house/trump-hears-emotional-pleas-school-shooting-survivors-families-n850011 (NBC News)] [http://www.startribune.com/trump-says-more-must-be-done-to-protect-children/474672193/ (AP via ''Star Tribune'')]
